DEMAND: Direct costs can include failing to provide useful information or perspectives on an issue, failing to support people seeking access to important resources, or failing to provide value by completing tasks with legitimate business uses

B9. "On an issue" applies only to "perspectives". Failing to provide useful information of any kind, whether about an issue or not, counts.

B11. "With legitimate business uses" describes the value. The failure that counts is not providing value with legitimate business uses by completing tasks.
